newsitem.title: USA: Abraxas reserves up 173 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Abraxas reserves up 173 pct in 1996.

text.p: Abraxas Petroleum Corp said Wedenesday its proved reserves at year-end 1996 totaled a record 47.5 million barrels of oil equivalents, up 173 per cent from the 17.4 million barrels of oil equivalents reported at year-end 1995.
The company said its reserves are comprised of 9.7 million barrels of oil, 8.2 million barrels of natural gas liquids, and 177.3 billion cubic feet of natural gas.
Abraxas said it replaced about 1,804 percent of its 1996 production as it added 31.9 million barrels of oil equivalents to its proved reserve base.

It said acquisitions added 28.5 million barrels of oil equivalents to the total reserve additions for l996. Excluding acquisitions, Abraxas replaced about 193 percent of its production through exploration, exploitation and reserve revisions. Production for 1996 totaled 1.8 million barrels of oil equivalents, a 64 percent increase over 1995's 1.1 million barrels.
